title: Freestanding Floor Standing Makeup Mirror, 8-Inch Double-Sided 2X/1X, Solid Brass - Traditional Style | Polished Nickel | Allied Brass
body_html:
Get a clear close-up for makeup or shaving, then flip for a true 1X view—without drilling into the wall in Polished Nickel, which offers a softer, warmer alternative to chrome with a subtle golden undertone that suits transitional spaces. This freestanding floor standing make-up mirror brings traditional styling to classic bath accessories and coordinates easily with heritage bathroom fixtures.

  • Polished Nickel coordinates seamlessly with chrome faucets and fixtures
  • Choose from 25 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Place it where you need it: Freestanding floor stand design requires no wall mounting.
  • Stable, confident use: Heavy solid brass base is designed to help prevent tipping.
  • Protects surfaces: Felt pad helps prevent scratching on floors and other surfaces.

Specs & details

  • Mirror: 8-Inch diameter, double faced mirror glass
  • Magnification: 2X (one side) / 1X (opposite side)
  • Material: Brass construction
  • Mounting type: Freestanding (floor standing)
  • Overall dimensions (L x W): 10.5 in x 10.5 in
  • Weight: 13.6 lb
  • Included: Make-up mirror
  • Assembly required: Yes
  • , including 25 options and statement colors

_previous.title: Adjustable Height Floor Standing Make-Up Mirror 8 Inch Diameter with 2X Magnification
_previous.description: Elegantly and efficiently designed, this floor standing 2 sided magnification mirror is an easy solution for your daily make-up or shaving routine.  The dual-sided mirror features a clear magnification for those close-up applications on one side and a 1x magnification on the opposite side for a quick all around check at any angle.  With classic accents, this free-standing vanity mirror is the crowning touch to your bathroom accessories.
